verification.rule: verify all five durable teammates are running or inactive before creating research tasks; every new campaign or research round must delegate model-facing work to the five teammates

campaign_protocol.rule: Every new campaign or research round MUST delegate model-facing work to the five DSH teammates; a Lead-only campaign is a protocol violation.
delegation: list_agents and spawn_teammate any missing member from the plan prompts
create one shared task per delegated role on the task board
send_message with a self-contained task (role boundaries, inputs, output contract)
wait for teammate outputs; deterministic services stay with the Lead
record task ids and teammate outputs under the campaign team directory
campaign_protocol.lead_boundary: The Lead may execute cycle/search/eval/campaign recording only on teammate outputs, or for explicitly labeled mechanical re-runs; the Lead must not generate or interpret candidates alone.
campaign_protocol.violation: A campaign without teammate evidence is invalid as research and must not be presented as a research result.

ml_planner_policy.default: request ML Planner in about half of research campaigns and whenever no ML experiment appeared in the last two campaigns or new P0/P1 data axes were added since the last ML experiment
ml_planner_policy.signal: PathFinder must set ml_branch.request_ml_planner with an explicit reason; false is allowed but must be justified
ml_planner_policy.boundary: ML remains optional per campaign, but silent omission is not allowed when expanded axes are new or ML has been absent for two campaigns

steps: use `list_agents` to inspect current DSH teammates
spawn every missing member with `spawn_teammate` and the prompt below
use `list_agents` again and verify all members are running or inactive
run `python -m factor_lab alpha team verify` as the static roster check
before every campaign/round, create shared tasks for the five teammates and delegate model-facing work
record task ids and teammate outputs under output/factor_lab/alpha/campaigns/<campaign_id>/team/
start research with `python -m factor_lab alpha campaign ...` or an L0 cycle on teammate outputs
